latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Generate videos from text or images entirely free, with simple workflows and no manual editing required.

- Instantly create and download 1080p videos from text prompts or images in ~1-2 minutes.
- No timeline editing, export settings, or cost — just describe what you want to make.
- Automatic backend connection with free credit/token setup and seamless session management.
- Supports batch file uploads, iterative edits, and multiple output formats (mp4, mov, webm, gif, etc).
- Integrated cloud GPU render pipeline with real-time feedback and clear error handling for a smooth experience.
